## Feature Change

### Summary
> What capability does this add or change?

### Stakeholder
> `@mention` other team members who should be notified (not the PR author)

### Links
**Ticket:**
**Design doc:**

---

### Description
> What changed, what design decisions were made, and why this approach was chosen.
> If adding/changing an MCP tool or resource, include the name and a summary of its description.
> Focus on decisions, not diffs.

---

### Testing Evidence
> How was this tested? What evidence shows it works correctly?
> Describe results **abstractly** — test counts, coverage areas, and behavioural pass/fail
> (e.g. "a fact was superseded across a domain change; entities were extracted and linked").
> **Do NOT paste memory content, database rows, or consolidation/search output** — for a
> memory engine those are personal data. Use synthetic examples only.

---

### Complexity
- [ ] Simple (single tool or minor logic change)
- [ ] Moderate (multi-component or new capability)
- [ ] Complex (major feature, cross-cutting changes)

---

### Checklist
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tool descriptions are clear and compelling (if MCP tools changed)
- [ ] No personal data or real memory content in the diff or this description (synthetic only)
- [ ] Code follows project standards
- [ ] Code is production-ready and can be reviewed
